authorization: User explicitly approved the current corrected model: two-hop onboard input offload, raw-input relay to ground, dt=0.1 seconds; retain the original three-day s3_gap30 load.
scope: Single synthetic high-resolution imaging architecture. This manifest freezes inputs and execution semantics, not future candidate scheduler implementations.

metrics.primary_definition: Number of released complete images whose final ground aggregation finishes within 300 seconds of release divided by ALL released images, including late, failed and unfinished images.
metrics.secondary_definition: Mean min(end-to-end image latency, 300 seconds) over ALL released images; failed or unfinished images contribute 300 seconds.
metrics.primary_aggregation: Equal-weight mean of per-day P_300 over nonempty days; report every empty day explicitly and separately report pooled task counts.
metrics.empty_day_rule: Keep every selected day. A zero-arrival day has P_300 and R_300 not applicable, never 0 or 1. Report zero arrivals, exclude it only from the undefined metric mean, disclose the number of nonempty days, and do not replace it.
metrics.all_empty_panel_rule: Report the panel as unevaluable; retain all dates and request user guidance without selecting replacements.

frozen_execution.routing_contract: Preserve the frozen common executor, reservation, cancellation and dynamic routing semantics. Do not turn predicted routes into a different fixed-path executor for a candidate.
frozen_execution.information_contract: Full topology prediction and current public queue state, no control-plane latency, identical information/action limits for paired policies; this is not a decentralized-information MARL claim.
frozen_execution.day_episode_rule: Each date starts with empty queues 120 seconds before its first qualifying acquisition, clipped to the date boundary; no cross-day residual carry-over. Retain all qualifying events on that date.
frozen_execution.visibility_precomputation_rule: Include the full frozen prediction horizon beyond the episode observation end. Changing episode duration is not assumed neutral for MARL features.

frozen_scene.structured_value_hash_rule: sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False).encode()) using Python's default separators
frozen_scene.satellite_compute_rates: All 24 satellite rates are 1.0 in the frozen proxy units, including the two imagers.
frozen_scene.compute_and_result_limitations: CPU/MPS detector proxy and inherited output-size/merge proxy, not calibrated flight GPU/server throughput or validated native PAN/MS preprocessing. Source compression, conversion and setup times remain excluded as in the frozen common model.

acquisition.rule: Apply the unchanged deterministic acquisition generator and keep every qualifying event; no selection by future ground contact, predicted scheduler outcome, or desired task count.

frozen_scene.full_parameter_authority: The three byte-hashed configuration files below contain all authoritative parameters, including exact TLE rows and exact per-day events. The summaries above do not replace those files.

source_evidence.core_hash_rule: sim.reproducibility.runtime_metadata: sorted sim/**/*.py then sorted root *.py; hash relative path, NUL, bytes, NUL for each file.
source_evidence.baseline_status: CGS is an adapted common-executor baseline, not a full reproduction of all original-paper routing and planning mechanisms.

sealed_test_selection.selection_rule: Choose the first six consecutive full UTC dates after all prior generated high-resolution geometry and its recorded forecast tail, with the entire tail-overlap date excluded. No RNG is used for choosing dates and no orbit or acquisition data are generated for selection.
sealed_test_selection.selection_seed_reason: Calendar ordering is deterministic; no random draw is used.
sealed_test_selection.load: s3_gap30 only; unchanged imagery, transport, computation and link parameters
sealed_test_selection.future_generation_rule: After method freeze, propagate the byte-identical synthetic TLE from its original epoch and apply the frozen acquisition generator over the continuous epoch-to-end interval, then retain only these six full-day event sets. Preserve prior spacing/cooldown state at boundaries; do not re-epoch TLE elements, reset phases, use ground opportunities to select events, or modify dates after seeing task counts.
sealed_test_selection.empty_day_rule: Retain and report every empty date under the metrics.empty_day_rule; no substitutes.
sealed_test_selection.unseal_condition: The candidate method, its parameters, comparison methods, variant history and reporting script are frozen and recorded before any test geometry or task schedule is generated or inspected. Run the fixed paired panel once and report all outcomes.
sealed_test_selection.post_unseal_tuning: Any tuning motivated by these dates consumes the test set; further confirmatory evaluation requires a newly predeclared panel rather than reusing it as unseen.
sealed_test_selection.generalization_limit: Six nearby dates in one deterministic synthetic constellation are correlated temporal/phase holdouts, not six independent satellite architectures or evidence of real ephemeris accuracy 37-42 days after an observed TLE. Fixed synthetic orbital elements are a model definition, not an aging real-world orbit estimate.

exclusion_evidence.inventory_scope: Parsed all 225 existing results/**/run.json, selection.json, *config.json and acquisition.json files before creating this manifest, without generating new geometry; zero JSON parsing failures.
exclusion_evidence.additional_literal_search: rg -l '2026-11-(21|22|23|24|25|26)' results docs analysis --glob '*.json' --glob '*.md' --glob '*.py' returned no matches before this manifest was created.
exclusion_evidence.previous_geometry_note: Although stored policy configurations selected only epoch offsets 7, 21 and 35, acquisition.json contains windows from the full continuous 36-day generation interval. Conservatively exclude the entire interval from unseen geometry claims.
exclusion_evidence.audit_limit: No selected date was found in the available persisted repository experiment metadata or text search. This evidence cannot prove absence of unrecorded or external experiments. If such prior use is discovered before unsealing, record it and obtain user guidance instead of silently replacing dates.
